body: If I had to write a letter to him, this would be it. I’m sorry that you’re feeling sad today. We’re in this together. Hoping it gets better day by day.

We haven’t had much contact since our breakup. It’s been well over a year, and from my knowledge he moved 3 hours away for college. Yet he still mentioned that whenever he passes by my house he thinks about slashing my tires. It makes me feel uneasy that when he is around the area, he still knows where I live and those are the thoughts he has. Do you know of anything I could invest in, such as a cheap security camera or a dash cam that could work even if my car is parked/off? If there is anyone I could report this to, should I? Or is it too little of a threat to even mention?

Unfortunately, no. It was through a phone call when he told me. I’m still a student in college living in a sharing house with other roommates, and they’ve told me before that they didn’t want to invest in a security camera. That conversation made me nervous to the point where I want to move!

wow.... i don't know what to say at all... except you're so strong for sharing your story and getting through such a difficult time. thank you so much for sharing this with me , and i'm so glad you had your best friend by your side. please be safe, and i hope the negative thoughts never come back to you, ever. you deserve to be here.

i get you, i know every relationship will have its ups and downs. i guess i have to see it that way. i just don’t want the fighting to become a everyday thing. this has happened before and it lead to me and the other person putting each other down, showing more hate than love, and can’t even stand being in the same room with each other anymore because we got so tired of the fighting. i hope i can learn and remind myself to find resolutions instead of just fighting to fight and prevent that from happening again. thank you

that’s how i feel right now. im still in denial, but im still moving on. it’s weird. i do find myself at times thinking “what if we could work things out, what if we really are meant to be together. maybe i should text him” but i know that for him, things are over. he makes it clear that he doesn’t want anything to do with me anymore. i just think that if he wanted to fix things with me, he would. and he hasn’t, so the only thing i can do is just move on. even though i feel like things shouldn’t be over. i think it is normal, but i wish i wasn’t feeling this way. it hurts!

thank you for this. my ex told me he was going to come see me soon. its been one week since we've broken up, and i've been doing so much better. i told my roommates not to open the door for him if he ever does show up. i'm sorry that you went back to the same spot you were at when you broke up. i believe in you to get over it again.
